record.paper_title: Some open problems related to small divisors
record.original_question: Let G_s denote the Gevrey-s class of one-variable formal germs, and for r>s>0 let g_{r,s} be the set of irrational α such that every F in G_s with multiplier e^{2πiα} is conjugate to the rotation R_α by a conjugacy H in G_r. Determine the arithmetic sets g_{r,s}.

evidence.quote: One knows that if a is a Brjuno number then for all s > 0 all germs F E G s have a linearization H E Gs ... Let r > s > 0 and denote gr,s={a E IR\Q, every FEGsis conjugated to Rawith a conjugacyH E Gr}

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a real number s>0, let $G_s$ denote the Gevrey-$s$ class of formal power series $F(z)=\sum_{n\ge 1} a_n z^n \in \mathbb{C}[[z]]$ with $F'(0)\ne 0$, namely those formal germs satisfying a bound of the form $|a_n|\le C\,K^n (n!)^s$ for some constants $C,K>0$. For an irrational number $\alpha\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Q}$, write $R_\alpha(z)=e^{2\pi i\alpha}z$ for the corresponding rotation, and say a germ $F\in G_s$ with multiplier $F'(0)=e^{2\pi i\alpha}$ is conjugate to $R_\alpha$ in $G_r$ if there exists a tangent-to-identity formal germ $H\in G_r$ with $H(0)=0$, $H'(0)=1$, such that $H^{-1}\circ F\circ H = R_\alpha$ as formal series.

For real numbers $r>s>0$, define
$$g_{r,s}\;=\;\bigl\{\,\alpha\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Q}\;:\;\text{every }F\in G_s\text{ with }F'(0)=e^{2\pi i\alpha}\text{ is conjugate to }R_\alpha\text{ via some }H\in G_r\,\bigr\}.$$

Determine the set $g_{r,s}$ explicitly as an arithmetic subset of $\mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Q}$; that is, characterize precisely which irrational numbers $\alpha$ belong to $g_{r,s}$ in terms of the Diophantine properties of $\alpha$ (e.g. continued fraction expansion, Brjuno-type sums).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of fully characterizing the sets $g_{r,s}$ for $r>s>0$ appears to remain open. It is classically known that every Brjuno number lies in $g_{s,s}$ (Carletti–Marmi), and recent work (e.g. Bounemoura and collaborators on optimal linearization in non-analytic Gevrey classes for circle diffeomorphisms and vector fields on the torus) has identified weaker-than-Brjuno arithmetic conditions when one allows the conjugacy to be less regular than the germ. However, a complete description of $g_{r,s}$ for arbitrary $r>s>0$ in the germ setting has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Linearization of germs: regular dependence on the multiplier
status_evidence.snippet: Brjuno condition is sufficient for the linearization to belong to the same Gevrey class as the germ.
status_evidence.claim: Brjuno sufficiency for same-class Gevrey linearization is known.

status_evidence.title: Optimal linearization of vector fields on the torus in non-analytic Gevrey classes
status_evidence.snippet: Identifies arithmetic conditions weaker than Brjuno when the conjugacy is allowed to be less regular than the data, in the Gevrey category.
status_evidence.claim: Weaker-than-Brjuno arithmetic sets appear when conjugacy regularity is lower; full characterization in the germ setting is not given.

status_evidence.title: Linearization of Gevrey flows on T^d with a Brjuno type arithmetical condition
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Brjuno-type arithmetic conditions sufficient for Gevrey linearization in the flow setting.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist; complete determination of g_{r,s} for germs is not reported.
